verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

xrefs.text: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.
Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

verses.text: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.

xrefs.text: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”

But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”

verses.text: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

xrefs.text: Why do the wicked live on, growing old and increasing in power?
Righteous are You, O LORD, when I plead before You. Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?
Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always continue in the fear of the LORD.
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
